en.title: BoE Rate Hold Probability Jumps on Fed Outlook
en.summary: The probability of the Bank of England maintaining interest rates after its September 2026 meeting increased to 66% (+8.5%), primarily driven by Natixis's forecast that the US Federal Reserve will hold rates through 2026. This sentiment is reinforced by the European Central Bank's decision to leave rates unchanged.
drivers: Natixis forecasts Fed to hold rates through 2026.
ECB leaves interest rates unchanged.
Money market rates at 5.00% on July 22, 2026.
en.why_matters: This indicates market confidence in stable UK monetary policy, influencing borrowing costs, inflation expectations, and economic growth. A prolonged period of stable rates affects investment decisions and consumer spending.
en.bull_case: Natixis's forecast for the Fed to hold rates through 2026 strongly suggests the BoE will follow a similar stable path.
en.bear_case: Upside risks from Iran and tariffs, as noted by Natixis, could still force the BoE to adjust rates.
